Tax Rate Calculation
Derry’s tax rate is a result of the sum of:
 Town Council approved budget to provide municipal services.
 Ballot vote in March 2026 by voters to provide school services.
 County Delegation budget to provide county services.
 State Education Tax– redistributed to communities
Divided by the amount of taxable property in Town = the Tax Rate
Tax Rate Calculation
Net Tax Commitment 2025 2026 Increase/Decrease
Municipal Services $30,495,574 $31,698,461 $ 1,202,887
Local School $67,045,708 $76,426,653 $ 9,380,945
State Education $ 6,334,154 $ 6,347,659 $      13,505
County $ 3,514,174 $ 3,817,977 $    303,803
Total
$107,389,610 $118,290,750 $10,901,140
Tax Rate Calculation
 2026 was a revaluation year! Total value increased from $5,660,323,534 to
$6,247,462,253.
 All property owners saw an average 9% increase in valuation. However,
individual assessments depend on the market value and condition.
 During the FY 27 Budget process, there was an assumed value for new
construction valuation of $50 million.
 Actual new construction added approximately $71 million
 New valuation represented 1.1% increase over 2025
 This altered the final tax rate for the Town from $5.39 down to $5.08
Tax Rate Calculation- Town
Town tax rate is constrained by a tax cap.
 The maximum allowable increase for the 2026 tax rate was determined by
the 2025 Consumer Price Index – Northeast at 3.3%
 FY 27 budget preparation calculated the allowable maximum as follows:
 2025 Tax Rate = $5.39
 2026 Allowable Max = $5.57 (3.3%) – before revaluation
 2026 Actual = $5.08 (2.7%) lower than allowable max due to new
construction
Tax Rate Calculation- School
 The 2026 School tax rate is not constrained by a tax cap.
 HB 1300 passed in November 2026 to now utilize a tax cap for two years.
 Voters approve the annual School District budget through deliberative session in
late January/early February followed by March vote.
 Warrant articles for contracts and special items are voted individually as part of
the annual March SB 2 voting process.
 2025 Tax Rate = $11.84
 2026 Tax Rate = $12.23
 THE TOWN COUNCIL DOES NOT CONTROL OR MANAGE THE SAU 10 BUDGET!
Real World Example
 For the municipal rate ONLY:
 An average house valued at $500,000 in 2025 paid
 $500,000 x $5.39/thousand = $2695
 Same house valued at $545,000 in 2026 (after 9% revaluation avg)
 $545,000 x $5.08/thousand = $2769
 Increase of $74 over 2025 or 2.7% increase
Takeaways
 The final Town tax rate increased 2.7% over last year, under the maximum allowable
increase of 3.3%.
 The FY 28 budget process starts in January 2027, the CPI-U allowable increase for
municipal operations is trending toward 4.3%- 4.5%.
 New valuation through development continues to be positive and it may afford the Town
some relief in future years. The baseline estimate for 2027 new construction will be $50
million, but may be adjusted higher based on review of projects.
 2026 Tax Bills are due January 5, 2027.
